svg.title: Zeeman external field conversion, potential curve, and Fullmag source boundaries
svg.desc: Panel (a) illustrates the single SI conversion from authored external flux density B_ext in tesla to H_ext = B_ext / mu_0 in amperes per meter, helical Larmor precession and Gilbert damping on the unit sphere, and the numerically plotted Zeeman energy density w_Z(theta) = -M_s B_ext cos(theta). Panel (b) contrasts uniform Zeeman(B) / study.b_ext across all four FDM/FEM CPU/GPU lanes with StaticFieldMap, RegionalFieldDrive, and RF antenna sources.
svg.text: Zeeman Interaction: Field Conversion, Potential Landscape, and Source Boundaries
Prescribed uniform induction B_ext [T] → H_ext = B_ext / μ₀ [A m⁻¹], conservative LLG precession, and spatial/RF separation
SI Conversion, Precession Sphere, and Potential w_Z(θ)
Single SI Conversion at Planning Boundary
Hext = Bext / μ0 HZ = Hext EZ = −μ0 ∫Ωm M · Hext dV = −∫Ωm M · Bext dV
Conservative torque vanishes at θ = 0, π
Angle θ between m and Bext
• Bext = 0 is legal and gives EZ = 0, HZ = 0.
• Bext → −Bext reverses HZ and EZ exactly.
Fullmag Boundary: Uniform Zeeman vs Spatial Maps & RF Drives
• Single spatially constant vector broadcast across active cells or magnetic nodes.
• Observables: Bext [T], Hext [A m−1], Eext [J]. FEM requires double precision.
Declared at most once per problem; zero Maxwell or current-transport solve.
• Arbitrary per-cell static Bext(xi) validated against realized FDM cell count.
• Rejected fail-closed by FEM planner and mutually exclusive with FDM Oersted.
• Spatial field profiles + explicit waveforms (Sinusoidal, Pulse, SincPulse, Piecewise).
• Evaluated at stage/RHS evaluation time t (never collapsed into constant Zeeman).
Validation Boundary, Provenance, and Fail-Closed Rules
• Requested intent preserves authored B [T] vs resolved Hext [A m−1], device & precision.
• Constructor audit note: Zeeman uses as_vector3 (length 3, float cast);
non-finite NaN/Inf is rejected at ProblemIR/planner validation.
• Strict GPU mode never falls back silently to CPU if device execution is unavailable.
Fullmag SI Zeeman contract: H_Z = B_ext / μ₀; conservative variational field H = −(μ₀ M_s)⁻¹ δE/δm.
